# module: cargo
# case:   base
# vars:
#   CARGO_BIN_UNIX=BASE-CARGO_BIN_UNIX
#   CARGO_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN=BASE-CARGO_FMT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   CARGO_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN=BASE-CARGO_LINT_SKIP_PATTERN
#   EXTRA_ARGS=BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
#   RUSTUP_INSTALL_URL=BASE-RUSTUP_INSTALL_URL
#   RUSTUP_INSTALL_URL_WINDOWS=BASE-RUSTUP_INSTALL_URL_WINDOWS
#   RUST_TOOLCHAIN=BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN

=== task: build ===





      filter "SKIPFILES_PATTERN=$skip_pattern" SKIPFILES_MATCHING=true |
      value=$0; sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*/, "", value); gsub(/["'"'"']/, "", value); print value; exit
      value=$0; sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*/, "", value); gsub(/["'"'"']/, "", value); print value; exit
    *" $package_name "*) ;;
    *" $package_name "*) ;;
    *) set -- "$@" --package "$package_name" ;;
    *) skipped_packages="$skipped_packages $package_name" ;;
    /^\[/ { in_package=0 }
    /^\[/ { in_package=0 }
    /^\[package\][[:space:]]*$/ { in_package=1; next }
    /^\[package\][[:space:]]*$/ { in_package=1; next }
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
    in_package && /^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=/ {
    in_package && /^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=/ {
    package_dir="$(dirname "$package_dir")"
    task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/cargo/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
    tr '\0' '
    }
    }
  "$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN build \
  "$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN build \
  ' "$manifest")"
  ' "$package_dir/Cargo.toml")"
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  [ -f "$package_dir/Cargo.toml" ] || continue
  [ -n "$package_name" ] || continue
  [ -n "$package_name" ] || continue
  case " $skipped_packages " in
  case " $skipped_packages " in
  done
  echo 'No matching Cargo packages found'
  esac
  esac
  exit
  exit
  exit 0
  find . -type f -name '*.rs' ! -path './target/*' ! -path './.git/*' -print0 |
  package_dir="$(dirname "$source_file")"
  package_name="$(awk '
  package_name="$(awk '
  while [ "$package_dir" != '/' ] && [ ! -f "$package_dir/Cargo.toml" ]; do
"$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN build "$@" \
'
)
done < <(
done < <(find . -type f -name Cargo.toml ! -path './target/*' ! -path './.git/*' | sort)
fi
fi
fi
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
if [ -z "$skip_pattern" ]; then
if [ -z "${skipped_packages# }" ]; then
set --
skip_pattern=''
skipped_packages=''
task: "_cargo:unix" finished
task: "_cargo:unix" started
task: "_cargo:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:unix" finished
task: "_install:unix" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "build" finished
task: "build" started
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_cargo:unix] cargo="$(command -v cargo || echo "BASE-CARGO_BIN_UNIX/cargo")"
task: [_install:unix] curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf "BASE-RUSTUP_INSTALL_URL" | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN
task: [_install:unix] echo 'Installing the Rust toolchain via rustup...'
task: [_install:unix] echo 'Rust installed. Restart your shell if cargo is not yet in PATH.'
task: status command command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN" ] || rustup show 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq "BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN"; } exited non-zero: exit status 1
while IFS= read -r manifest; do
while IFS= read -r source_file; do

=== task: check ===

      value=$0; sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*/, "", value); gsub(/["'"'"']/, "", value); print value; exit
      value=$0; sub(/^[^=]*=[[:space:]]*/, "", value); gsub(/["'"'"']/, "", value); print value; exit
    *" $package_name "*) ;;
    *" $package_name "*) ;;
    *) set -- "$@" --package "$package_name" ;;
    *) skipped_packages="$skipped_packages $package_name" ;;
    /^\[/ { in_package=0 }
    /^\[/ { in_package=0 }
    /^\[package\][[:space:]]*$/ { in_package=1; next }
    /^\[package\][[:space:]]*$/ { in_package=1; next }
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
    BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
    in_package && /^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=/ {
    in_package && /^[[:space:]]*name[[:space:]]*=/ {
    package_dir="$(dirname "$package_dir")"
    task --silent --taskfile "$REPO/taskfiles/cargo/../internal/skipfiles/Taskfile.yml" \
    tr '\0' '
    }
    }
  "$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN check \
  "$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN check \
  ' "$manifest")"
  ' "$package_dir/Cargo.toml")"
  BASE-EXTRA_ARGS
  [ -f "$package_dir/Cargo.toml" ] || continue
  [ -n "$package_name" ] || continue
  [ -n "$package_name" ] || continue
  case " $skipped_packages " in
  case " $skipped_packages " in
  done
  echo 'No matching Cargo packages found'
  esac
  esac
  exit
  exit
  exit 0
  find . -type f -name '*.rs' ! -path './target/*' ! -path './.git/*' -print0 |
  package_dir="$(dirname "$source_file")"
  package_name="$(awk '
  package_name="$(awk '
  while [ "$package_dir" != '/' ] && [ ! -f "$package_dir/Cargo.toml" ]; do
"$cargo" +BASE-RUST_TOOLCHAIN check "$@" \
'
)
done < <(
done < <(find . -type f -name Cargo.toml ! -path './target/*' ! -path './.git/*' | sort)
fi
fi
fi
